study: Do the desk's square arms do worse when price is inside, or just under, an overhead order block that was already known at the decision?
registered_at: 2026-10-05 (during RTH; nothing run until after the close), before any order-block feature was computed on the sample
origin: Operator, 10/5: ETHA and EWZ losses 'did not move out of the resistance' (LuxAlgo Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks). Port check the same day: EWZ 10:11 entry was inside a bearish OB (43.39-43.95) known since 08:09 (would flag); ETHA's zone (20.49-20.59) became known at 10:35, after the 10:13 entry (would NOT flag). TradingView draws boxes back to the origin candle, which looks like look-ahead on a chart.
indicator: tools/order_blocks.py, a point-in-time port of 'Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks [LuxAlgo]' with default inputs (swing lookback 10, wicks). A block is usable only from the close of the bar that confirmed it. Port checked to the cent against the operator's ETHA 5m and EWZ 1m charts on 10/5.
sample: the 2026-10-02 indicator-levels sample, unchanged (ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json, ext.pkl): E = 1,809 square arms at $10+, 09:40-15:30, on 16 days 9/11-10/02 (9/11 has 5 arms), one per name per 15 min; F = 348 desk fills at $10+ on 8 days since 9/23. Outcome net15 = 15 min after entry minus 0.20% round trip, as registered then. Halves are alternate days: about 8 day-clusters per half for E (t <= -2 is about p 0.085 on 7 df) and 4 for F. These days were mined on 10/02 with about 7 S/R indicators (never order blocks); 'just under PDH' overlaps.
feature: RESIST = the price at the decision is inside, or within 0.3% below, a resistance block known before the decision, among the blocks LuxAlgo charts (the last 3 bullish and last 3 bearish blocks, breakers included, newest first): an unbroken bearish OB, or a bullish breaker. Blocks come from premarket + RTH 1-minute SIP bars (04:00-16:00) of the prior day and today. 'All blocks in memory' is information only.
primary: E arms, 1-minute bars, charted blocks, within 0.3%: net15 regressed on a RESIST dummy with DAY FIXED EFFECTS (y and RESIST demeaned within day), day-clustered (CR1) t, separately in halves A and B. The raw (no-FE) diff is reported as information.
pass: diff <= -5 bp AND t <= -2 AND >= 50 RESIST arms, in BOTH halves -> PASS, which earns a held-out confirmation on >= 10 new sessions (10/5 onward) before any config change; it is not a gate yet. Fewer than 50 RESIST arms in a half -> UNDERPOWERED, no verdict. Otherwise FAIL, which means 'no large effect': with net15 SD 123-153 bp and ~50 flagged arms the SE is ~22 bp, so t <= -2 needs about -45 bp; a small effect cannot be ruled out.
information_only: E and F on 5-minute bars (resampled from the same 1-minute)
E and F on 10-minute bars, and 'a charted zone on ANY of 1/5/10m' (added 2026-10-05 before any run, operator question; information only, any promising one needs its own pre-registration on new days)

operator hypotheses 10/5 (information only, added before any run): BREAKOUT = a charted bearish OB broken upward (became a breaker) within the last 15 min with price above its top, vs other arms (day FE); ROOM = % from price up to the bottom of the nearest charted resistance block above, terciles cut on half A plus 'none above'. Prior: the 10/02 study found resistance breaks were the WORST cell on four other indicators and more room to PDH/PMH/HOD/whole-dollar did not help.

operator 10/5, before any run: BREAKOUT DISTANCE = % of price above the top of the most recently broken charted bearish OB (break within 15 min), in fixed bands poke 0-0.10%, clean 0.10-0.30%, running 0.30-0.60%, extended >0.60%; each band vs non-breakout arms with day FE. Information only.
all blocks in memory instead of the charted 3 per side

F (fills): net15 and realized round trip, flagged vs rest; F uses the last bar closed before the FILL, which can be up to one bar after the arm decided (at most one bar of look-ahead; information only)
medians and a winsorized (+/-300 bp) day-FE diff
share of arms flagged (the opens a skip rule would cost)
rows with no usable bar before the decision (counted)
no_retuning: the 0.3% band, swing length 10, the timeframe and the resistance definition are fixed here; any change is a new pre-registration
prior: low-moderate. 10/02: no S/R level separated arms reliably; the only same-sign fill cell was 'just under the prior-day high' (n 22/15). Order blocks are new.
caveats: port is from the published logic as remembered; checked on two charts only
net15 is a fixed 15-minute hold, not the desk's trail exit
amended: 2026-10-05, before any run, per the skeptic's FIX FIRST: charted 3-per-side blocks primary, day fixed effects, sample counts corrected (16 days, 1,809 arms), UNDERPOWERED/FAIL wording, premarket+RTH, F look-ahead noted
